required_verification: Focused command lifecycle tests cover pairing, duplicate run ids after completion, source seq validation, invalid baseline rejection, late companion registration from owner state, and rejected-candidate state preservation.

Focused permission invariant tests cover configured/Auto history, unknown current and historical names, and session creation rollback; existing permission projection tests confirm its currentValue view and persisted state version are unchanged.

Focused ApprovalService and invariant tests cover open-turn current reads, latest policy override/default behavior, all existing audit validation order, accepted cancellation pairs, observer failures, restore/fork creation baselines, late companion registration, and state cleanup.

Run the listed command and approval consumer tests to confirm user-visible command results and approval integrations do not change; the three approved fixture tests and five unchanged consumer tests all remain in the batch.

Run scoped host TypeScript and Oxlint for the three packages; verify-type-equiv, verify-cordis-catalog, export-JSDoc, translation pairing, package READMEs, scoped doc-typecheck/doc-quick, and git diff --check.
Confirm the S041-S046 deprecated-reader count decreases by six and no implementation path retains a synchronous eventAt or snapshotEvents call for those sites.
No SDK projection output or model-visible wording changes are expected; update snapshots only if a focused output assertion demonstrates an actual behavior change.

For commands, permission-presets, and user-approval, unload the owning provider while a Session remains attached, append an event while its listener is absent, and reactivate. Verify teardown removes the old fold and activation fails closed before a stale current read or invariant check; verify an empty live Session can seed from the empty prefix.

For commands, permission-presets, and user-approval, create two scoped providers observing one Session. Release one lease and verify the other continues reads, pre-commit validation, and event advancement; reacquire while the sibling lease is active and retain exact state. After final lease release, verify eventful Session activation fails closed and empty Session activation seeds the empty prefix.
The three successor consumer fixtures establish exact Session creation baselines and the required SessionProjectionRegistry before invoking the changed consumers.

The existing-knobs permission test expects late projection registration to reject with the exact missing-baseline error and confirms the original sandbox/mode and approval/policy events remain unchanged.
Only the three authorized test files and the explicitly named gate/allowlist control-plane records change; the other five verification-only test files remain byte-identical.
